connectors.name: Perplexity MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Gives Claude Code live internet access through Perplexity search, so answers reflect the current web. Useful for up-to-date research while coding.
connectors.install_or_source: MCP server (add to Claude Code config)

connectors.name: Playwright MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Lets Claude Code drive a real browser: navigate, click, fill forms, run tests and upload files. Turns the agent into a browser operator.

connectors.name: Firecrawl MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Crawls and scrapes entire websites into clean text for RAG and context. Handles JS-heavy pages and can bypass many captchas.

connectors.name: Glyph MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude Code to image and video generation models and optimizes the prompts sent to them. Acts as a bridge to media-gen backends.
connectors.paid_version: depends on the connected media model

connectors.name: Chrome MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Lets Claude interact with your already-open Chrome browser, reading tabs and acting on the current page. Handy for working inside logged-in sessions.

connectors.name: Hostinger MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Gives Claude 118 tools to deploy and manage hosting: spin up a VPS, manage domains and ship sites without leaving the agent. Effectively a deployment backend for Claude.

connectors.name: Viralo
connectors.what_it_does: A custom Claude connector that streams real-time data on 4M+ short-form videos across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. Lets Claude spot and ride current trends for content.
connectors.install_or_source: Add as a custom connector in Claude: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector (paste the Viralo URL + API key)

connectors.name: Gemini AI MCP Server (Bhansalisoft)
connectors.what_it_does: An MCP server hosted on Apify that exposes Gemini AI capabilities to automation and agent workflows. It allows other tools to call Gemini via the MCP protocol.

connectors.name: Higgsfield MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other LLMs to Higgsfield AI's marketing platform, enabling trend research, content planning, batch UGC video generation, and Meta Ads scheduling from a single chat session.

connectors.name: Figma AI MCP Server (Bhansalisoft)
connectors.what_it_does: An MCP server on Apify that connects Figma to AI automation workflows, enabling AI-assisted design processing. Details are limited in the source video.

connectors.name: Metricool MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude to Metricool's social media management platform, enabling scheduling posts, pulling analytics, finding best posting times, and analyzing competitors across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Meta Ads, and Google Ads — all from one Claude chat.
connectors.install_or_source: Add as a connector in Claude settings (Metricool MCP)

connectors.name: Manus Gmail Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Manus AI to Gmail, enabling the agent to draft and send emails directly from the user's inbox as part of automated lead outreach or deal re-engagement workflows.
connectors.install_or_source: Available natively within Manus AI — connect via Manus connectors settings

connectors.name: Manus Google Calendar Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Manus AI to Google Calendar, enabling the agent to read events, create calendar blocks, and run automated calendar audits with Slack reporting on a defined schedule.
connectors.install_or_source: Available natively within Manus AI — connect via Manus connectors settings

connectors.name: Manus Telegram Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Manus AI to Telegram, providing a mobile-accessible chat interface that supports voice, text, and image inputs and enables proactive agent-initiated morning briefings.
connectors.install_or_source: Available natively within Manus AI — connect via Manus connectors settings

connectors.name: Alexa + Claude Integration
connectors.what_it_does: Amazon Alexa voice assistant powered by Anthropic Claude, enabling multi-turn dialogue, complex task handling, and persistent cross-session memory via voice.
